name: PCD Ops
description: The day-two dashboard. Resource reclamation, cluster capacity planning with what-if analysis, a searchable inventory, snapshot management, right-sizing recommendations from real Prometheus usage, and anomaly and drift detection.
includes: Idle VMs, orphaned volumes, stale snapshots
AI triage, cloud-hosted or on-premises Ollama

configuration.label: AI backend
configuration.help: Used for AI right-sizing, anomaly and log analysis. For Claude, enter the API key on the PCD Ops Settings page after install.

configuration.label: AI endpoint URL
configuration.help: Ollama base URL or OpenAI-compatible endpoint, reachable from the appliance.

configuration.label: AI model
configuration.help: Model name on the endpoint, e.g. llama3.1:8b.

post_deploy_notes: Open the web UI and enter PCD and Grafana details (and the Claude API key, if used) under Settings. AI settings from the install form are defaults; anything saved on the Settings page wins. The appliance has no sshd; manage it from the VM console menu.
